title: Na$_2$Ir$^\text{IV}$Cl$_6$: The Missing Member of the Perfectly Cubic Vacancy Ordered $A_2$IrCl$_6$ Family, Another Potential $J_{eff}$ = $\frac{1}{2}$ Ground State Candidate
authors: Siddhartha Sankar Soren, Aditya Patra, Rounak Das, Ritwik Das, Tanmay Chanda, Jens Buck, Indra Dasgupta, Sugata Ray
abstract: Vacancy ordered double perovskites (VODPs) have been known for more than 100 years, but their exact crystal structures and magnetic ground state remained controversial till date. Anhydrous VODP iridates ($A_2$Ir$X_6$; $A$ = K$^+$, (NH$_4$)$^+$, Cs$^+$, Rb$^+$, and $X$ = F$^-$, Cl$^-$, Br$^-$), having $face-centered~cubic$ (fcc) antiferromagnetic ground state, offer a chemically well-defined platform to investigate the influence of on-site Coulomb repulsion, crystal field, spin-orbit coupling, and competing Heisenberg and Kitaev interactions. Interestingly, among these, the Na-based VODP iridates seem to possess an unusual hydration dependent structural and magnetic uncertainty. As a result, a cubic Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ system having fcc antiferromagnetism could not be stabilized ever. Here, for the first time, we report the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of anhydrous Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ single crystals having fcc structure with antiferromagnetic transition temperature of 1.91 K. Thermogravimetric analysis establishes the absence of lattice water and also demonstrates thermal stability of the crystals up to 453 K. The cubic phase reported here contrasts with previously described 'anhydrous' monoclinic Na$_2$IrCl$_6$ and highlights the strong structural and physical property relationship in Na-based VODP iridates. This new material offers an exciting playing ground for exploring another potential perfect $J_{eff}$ = $\frac{1}{2}$ octahedra and the consequent strong Kitaev interaction within the nearest-neighbor (nn) pairs of Ir ions.
summary: This paper reports the synthesis and characterization of anhydrous $	ext{Na}_2	ext{IrCl}_6$, a material that realizes the perfectly cubic structure predicted for the $	ext{A}_2	ext{IrCl}_6$ family. By confirming its structure and observing antiferromagnetism, the authors provide a crucial platform to experimentally investigate the theoretical physics of $J_{eff} =  rac{1}{2}$ ground states and Kitaev interactions in strongly correlated iridates.
main_problem: The study investigates the structural and magnetic properties of vacancy ordered double perovskites (VODPs), specifically aiming to realize and characterize the potential $J_{eff} =  rac{1}{2}$ ground state associated with Kitaev interactions.
main_result: The authors report the first synthesis and characterization of anhydrous $	ext{Na}_2	ext{IrCl}_6$ single crystals exhibiting a cubic structure and long-range antiferromagnetic order at $1.91 	ext{ K}$. This material serves as a key candidate for exploring the ideal $J_{eff} =  rac{1}{2}$ physics.
method: The work combines experimental techniques (synthesis, TGA, XRD, XPS, DC magnetization) with theoretical modeling (DFT calculations of exchange interactions).
model_or_system: The system is the $	ext{A}_2	ext{IrCl}_6$ family of VODPs, where $	ext{Ir}^{4+}$ ions in an octahedral environment are modeled to exhibit strong spin-orbit coupling, leading to low-energy magnetic degrees of freedom described by $S=1/2$ pseudospins and the Kitaev-Heisenberg Hamiltonian.
key_observables: Antiferromagnetic transition temperature ($T_N = 1.91 	ext{ K}$), effective magnetic moment ($\mu_{	ext{eff}} = 1.71 \mu_{	ext{B}}$), and the confirmation of the cubic $Fm ar{3}m$ structure.
important_parameters: The system is characterized by the competition between Heisenberg, Kitaev, and symmetric exchange interactions ($J, K, \Gamma$).
main_assumptions: The primary assumption is that the ideal cubic structure allows for the realization of the perfect $J_{eff} =  rac{1}{2}$ ground state, contrasting with previously observed monoclinic phases.
figures_summary: Figures illustrate the cubic crystal structure, the nearest-neighbor superexchange pathway, and the experimental X-ray powder diffraction patterns confirming the crystal structure.
paper_structure: The paper establishes the context of VODPs and the $J_{eff}$ physics, details the synthesis and structural characterization of the new cubic $	ext{Na}_2	ext{IrCl}_6$ phase, presents magnetic measurements confirming antiferromagnetism, and theoretically models the resulting magnetic interactions.
why_interesting: The strong correlation, spin-orbit coupling, and the explicit connection to the Kitaev model make this highly relevant for understanding exotic quantum magnetic states in solid-state materials.
